entries.title: II Thessalonians 2:2
segments: By epistle as from us. The inference must be that a letter falsely declared to be from Paul, had been used to uphold the contention of a faction in the Thessalonian church which believed the second coming of Christ to be at hand.  It is probable that this incident, with the continued fanatical excitement of the people, led Paul to write this second epistle.  See note
